Three Samajwadi Party MLAs Join BJP in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh

Three Samajwadi Party (SP) MLAs, Rakesh Pratap Singh, Abhay Singh, and Vinod Chaturvedi, have formally joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. The MLAs had been out of the SP for over a year and had cross-voted in the 2024 Rajya Sabha polls. Akhilesh Yadav stated that after years of waiting, they received nothing more than a membership slip, signaling a political split and boosting the BJP's prospects in the state.
